name: coregenie
description: A Chinese Agent workbench for 3GPP standards research and knowledge workflows.
author: CoreGenie contributors

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server lint && pnpm --filter anything-llm-frontend lint && pnpm --filter @coregenie/collector lint
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server lint:check && pnpm --filter anything-llm-frontend lint:check && pnpm --filter @coregenie/collector lint:check
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:envs && pnpm prisma:setup && echo "Please run pnpm dev:server and pnpm dev:frontend in separate terminal tabs."
scripts.setup:envs: cp -n ./frontend/.env.example ./frontend/.env; cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development; cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env; echo "All ENV files copied!\n"
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:seed: pnpm --filter anything-llm-server exec prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm prisma:migrate && pnpm prisma:seed
scripts.translations:normalize: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && pnpm --filter anything-llm-frontend lint && pnpm translations:verify
scripts.translations:prune: cd frontend/src/locales && node findUnusedTranslations.mjs --delete && cd ../../../ && pnpm translations:normalize
scripts.translations:create: cd extras/translator && node index.mjs --all && cd ../../frontend && pnpm lint && cd ../..
